cities.name: Hub
cities.description: Walled concentric capital of the Concordant Compact — city-state, no single crown. Four-way power (Scholars, Merchants, Iron Wardens, Shadow Network) shares the Heart. Resonance Stone and Unburned Court sit in the civic core.

cities.name: Pinewood Crossing
cities.description: Salt road hold outside the Warden ring-wall. Year 80 brothers lore. Medium-ring approach landmark on the Crown Road spoke.

cities.name: Broken Spire
cities.description: North shore wreck from the Three-Day War. Cross-world dungeon scars. Medium-ring approach landmark on the Crown Road spoke.

cities.name: Upper Grove
cities.description: Verdant Veil approach; root-cellars dungeon mouth. Medium-ring approach landmark on the Crown Road spoke.

cities.name: Three Refusals Tavern
cities.description: Roadhouse and rumor mill on the Crown Road approach. Medium-ring approach landmark (tavern mass + annex).
